programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Directed by Abbas Mustan, Race features Saif Ali Khan and Akshaye Khanna as rival brothers in the horse racing business. With twists and turns at every corner, the film delves into themes of greed and betrayal, keeping audiences guessing until the end.

programme.title: Love Hostel
programme.desc: Love Hostel is a gritty romantic thriller that explores the dark realities of honor killings in India. The story follows Ashu and Jyoti, a couple from different religious backgrounds who elope to escape the wrath of their families. As they seek a new beginning, they are relentlessly hunted by a ruthless mercenary hired to restore "family honor." Starring Vikrant Massey, Sanya Malhotra, and Bobby Deol, the film is a raw and intense portrayal of love caught in the crossfire of social prejudice and violence. Directed by Shanker Raman, the movie is a chilling commentary on intolerance and the price of defiance.

programme.title: Kismat Konnection
programme.desc: Directed by Aziz Mirza, this romantic comedy stars Shahid Kapoor as Raj Malhotra, an unsuccessful architect whose luck turns around after meeting Priya (Vidya Balan). programme.title: Tejas
programme.desc: Indian Air Force officer Tejas sets out on a dangerous mission to rescue an Indian spy from Pakistan. As she faces off against the adversaries that come her way, she finds herself also fighting the ghosts of her past.
